name: skill-governance
description: Audit and repair portable skill governance, add optional cross-harness runtime guards, maintain lightweight work tracking, and audit opted-in Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Govern skills, documents, and repository work
interface.longDescription: Install a portable governance pack, audit skill packages and lifecycle metadata, add optional repository-scoped runtime guards shared by Claude Code and Codex, audit opted-in governed Markdown, and maintain a lightweight roadmap, epic, and task tracker. Audits remain advisory by default. Strong enforcement also requires administrator-protected policy, restricted bypass capabilities, an external approval verifier, and isolated publisher credentials.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's governed Markdown documents.
Identify which governance rules are actually enforced.
Check the roadmap, epics, and tasks.
